clips.title: The story
paras: Invisibility Liquor gives Maybell Maclure a way to slip from her family's sight and meet Tommy Joe Stonefield. Their households are locked in a feud.

Tommy Joe Stonefield seeks a quiet meeting with Maybell Maclure, though their families' feud keeps the households apart. Their kin watch closely, and ordinary secrecy is not enough. Invisibility Liquor lets the drinker pass unseen across the disputed farmland.
